The '''ISS-944 Power Droid''' was a combat-prepared [[Power droid/Legends|power droid]] owned by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and used aboard the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Emperor's Glory]]'' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> it was destroyed by a boarding party from a Republic transport [[Esseles (starship)|''Esseles'']].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ISS-944 Power Droid appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a bonus boss in the Hard Mode version of "The Esseles" flashpoint.<ref name="SWTOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
